title: Videos folder
whyItMatters: Phone videos, screen recordings and clips of private moments sit here. The files are large and easy to forget before handing a machine over.
source: XDG user directories defaults (xdg-user-dirs creates Videos under the home directory): https://www.freedesktop.org/wiki/Software/xdg-user-dirs/
notes: The folder name comes from ~/.config/user-dirs.dirs and can be localised or renamed, which this rule does not detect. Screen recorders often default to this folder or to the home directory.

steps: Open the folder named in the plan in your file manager.
Copy any personal videos or screen recordings you wish to keep to external storage.
Delete the remaining video files and folders in Videos.
Empty the Trash, because deleted files wait there until you do.
cleanup.risk: The files leave the folder; until the Trash is emptied they can still be restored, and after that only copies made elsewhere survive.
